title: Let's Turn On
notes:
All tracks written, produced & engineered, fixed, tweaked, freaked & gurned at Doof Studios
Except track A1: engineered at Hallucinogen Sound Labs, London.
Track  B1: edited at The Townhouse
Track B2: Courtesy of Dragonfly Records, engineered at Butterfly Studios.
All mastered at The Townhouse

℗ 1996 TIP Records
